name: ci-beacon
description: Status line with the latest GitHub Actions run for the current branch, refreshed on a timer and after each turn, with a toast when a run finishes.

poll_seconds.title: Refresh interval
poll_seconds.description: Seconds between checks of the latest run.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Only show runs of this workflow (its name or file name). Empty shows the latest run of any workflow.
